pins.move: grep -rlE 'companygraph/mcp-server[^[:space:]"]*(#|@|\?ref=)v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' package.json .github/workflows infra | xargs perl -pi -e 's~(companygraph/mcp-server[^\s"]*?(?:#|@|\?ref=))v\d+\.\d+\.\d+~${1}{version}~g' && npm install

grep -rlE 'companygraph/chat-server[^[:space:]"]*(#|@|\?ref=)v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' chat/package.json .github/workflows infra | xargs perl -pi -e 's~(companygraph/chat-server[^\s"]*?(?:#|@|\?ref=))v\d+\.\d+\.\d+~${1}{version}~g' && npm install --prefix chat

verify: GITHUB_TOKEN=${GITHUB_TOKEN:-$(gh auth token)} npm run snapshot
